environment.description: Kubernetes deployment behind an Istio service mesh (v1.20.2) with PeerAuthentication policy set to STRICT mode on the namespace, requiring mTLS for all inbound connections. The Istio ingress gateway has a custom EnvoyFilter resource that enforces downstream client certificate validation against an internal CA (mounted as a Secret named 'mesh-client-ca' in istio-system). Additionally, an AuthorizationPolicy resource scopes the /api/v1/metadata path to principals matching 'cluster.local/ns/metrics-pipeline/sa/collector-sa' only. The sidecar proxy (envoy) terminates TLS before traffic reaches the application container on port 8080. Requests without a valid client certificate signed by the internal CA are rejected at the envoy sidecar with HTTP 403 before reaching the Go process.
